p1: Seven people died from a headache pill... and the killer put the bottles back on the shelf.
Day one: a postal worker takes Extra-Strength Tylenol... and dies that same day.
His brother and sister-in-law come to his home.
They ask for some Tylenol... from the same bottle.
Someone had opened the capsules... and filled them with cyanide.
Police believe he took bottles off store shelves, poisoned them... and put them back.
Thirty-one million bottles are pulled across America.
Then a man writes to the company, demanding one million dollars to stop the killing.
He goes to prison for extortion... but he's never charged with the murders.
He always denied it. He died in 2023.
The Tylenol killer has never been found.
That seal you peel off every new bottle of pills? It's there because of him.
